title: Create - Brand New World
description: A cozy tech modpack all about Create and Aeronautics
body:
## Create - Brand New World

A new modpack made for Create Aeronautics!

![A custom-made plane flies through the skies. In the background there is a rocky formation, leading to a lake.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f3ef05e94b3e01988d7177d205fd58cf8f71d59.png)


> Cute animals, beautiful biomes, cozy furniture, lots of cooking recipes and many different technologies to create (pun intended!) and explore...

---

### Contents:

- Performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, EntityCulling...)
- Create + addons (Aeronautics, Slice & Dice, Sounds of Steam, Power Grid...)
- Let's do Series (Farm & Charm, Bakery, Vinery, Brewery...)
- YUNGS Mods (Better Caves, Desert Temples, Dungeons, Mineshafts...)
- Terralith and Continents
- Naturalist, Hybrid Aquatic, Fowl Play
- Lots of QOL mods (Zoom, Amendments, AutoHUD, Carry On...)
- Cute resource packs and Complementary Shaders
